payload.body: molt-dc READY 0089: branch dc/0089-ci-no-tags, head bed5ce9, one commit on main at 25eb6e3, worktree $TMPDIR/molt-wt/dc-0089-ci-no-tags. tests.yml: on.push keeps branches [main, candidate/**] and paths-ignore, with no tags key, and a comment saying why. test-macos's if and Test Summary's MACOS_REQUIRED are now workflow_dispatch || candidate/, with the tag case gone. The concurrency comment says a candidate has its own ref. The workflow README (the trigger list, the table's macOS row, the one-platform tip), RULES.md:20 and ARCHITECTURE.md:38 drop the tag runs. Proof, no slot needed since nothing here is shell: actionlint is clean on the branch's tests.yml and on main's. A YAML parse reads on.push's keys as branches and paths-ignore, and both conditions as dispatch or candidate. bin/devbin ci-state --fires at bed5ce9 reads a candidate/v1.4.3 push changing VERSION and CHANGELOG.md as fires, a candidate push changing only board and canon files as quiet, and a main push changing lib/env.sh as fires. GitHub starts no push run for a tag when on.push names branches and no tags. ARCHITECTURE.md also changes in 0088, at line 27, a different hunk. The CHANGELOG line goes on main at your merge.
